comments: Viv is a very nice host and her hour is wonderful. Very good vibes and you feel like at home.

Excellent view over Greenpoint, which is a great base for exploring the city. I had a lovely and quiet stay here, many thanks to the hosts who provided smooth and great service. The view from the balcony is very charming.

we stayed only a night and had the chance the use the garden space as a location for a photo-shoot. maureen was very friendly in her messages. katya welcomed us and she was lovely with her little son. we were the first guests in this house and we really enjoyed staying there. everything was on point. all the little details, the fresh lavender on the towels or the welcoming flowers, or the refreshing cold water as we arrived. the interior is well picked and the furniture is not from ikea - which is nowadays not normal on airbnb! i highly recommend maureens beautiful and quiet house. the next supermarket is only 2min drive from the apartment. a perfect house for family or a group of friends ! thanks xxx

First time in Cape Town and Africa and couldn't ask for more! The apartment is amazing with fantastic views of table mountain. Claire suggested to use Uber to get around town and it was 100% the right call, especially with all the amazing restaurants and bars. We have stayed in a few airbnb's and the book that Claire has made for the surrounding areas is second to none! Thank you for making the end for our honeymoon the best!!! A + K

This studio is spacious for a solo traveler and would be good for two as well. It has high celling and many windows therefore its very airy. It's well furnished, with modern equipment and everything else beyond your expection, just like home. The view is fantastic. You could watch the sunrise and sunset also the beautiful Table Mountain in bed. The street is quiet and safe, close to the Kloof Street. it is exciting to rent a car and travel around the city otherwise you can take Uber to all interesting places. Our hosts are very nice and welcoming. They prepared extra duvet, blankets, chocolate and wines to make you feel like home. I highly recommend you to stay in this place if you are traveling to Cape Town.

Nick and Tanya's place was amazing! We had a truly wonderful experience. The location was awesome, right near Giovanni's which turned out to be soooo convenient. Great views, and every piece if information you'd ever need. Would definitely recommend this to any traveler. Thanks again.... Looking forward to seeing you soon! Sara and Ben
Wonderful area, comfortable beds and nice kitchen with serious coffee machine. Boat-Pedalling in the Marina was great fun. See you again next year

Apartment was exactly what we expected, so we loved it. It was a bit hard to find because our gps sent us to a different location in another area when we came from the airport, so just be cautious that you are going to the right location. Having to go downstairs to get from the parking spot to the correct floor for the apartment was a pain to remember but we got used to it. I wish there had been some local tips or activities/restaurant suggestions from the owner that other Airbnb’s I have visited have had in the past because I’ve found those super helpful. But other than that, it was exactly what was expected and had an amazing view of table mountain! Great value!

We had a great time staying at Charl's place, the house is as amazing as it looks on the pictures. Communication was super easy and Patrick (caretaker who is living on the property) helped us out with everything we needed at anytime. We would definitely come back!
Another outstanding stay! Michele is an amazing host. The location is fabulous with all mod-cons on offer.

We spent out first few nights in SA here and are really happy with everything! The place is very nice, spacious and the common garden and pool are fantastic too! Bettina and Dieter were lovely hosts, very caring and communicative. We enjoyed every minute and can only recommend it! Thank you Bettina and Dieter for a lovely stay!

Llandudno is a beautifully tranquil spot and Jed and Mels place is a slice of heaven. Everything was great and the house had everything we needed. They were extremely welcoming and made us feel right at home. I would highly recommend this place.

This is a lovely and stylish studio cabin with stunning views. Colette has recently installed a fireplace which adds to the ambience in winter and accommodated a late check out for me on the day I left.
It was one of the best apartment I ever found . Rayan & Khaled Very helpful and fast response The apartment is much much better than I expected much better than how it’s appear in the photo. Hilal

The location of Lorraine’s home is perfect. We were able to walk many places and Uber never had a problem finding us. The place was clean and the building is secure with a guard 24 hours and fob system. The views of Table Mountain were incredible!

We really enjoyed our stay ay Treetops, a great location in Constantia really close to the shops but at the same time quiet and peaceful. Janice was a great host. The fast broadband was a definite plus. We will be going back I can't give a higher recommendation than that.
The place was perfect, great hospitality with a beautiful view of Table Mountain. Thank you very much!
Thanks Maeva for having us. Very quite and nice location in sunset 10min was from the beach. Lots of dogs in the neighborhood so it can get loud very early.

Communication and local tips was very good and if you want to stay a place were the host is informative and quick to response, you get the best right here. the place was very nice and the pictures is as the description. You have a fantastic view of the table Mountain and Cape Town from the beach. The only drawback was the ocean were polluted to a level where it was not advisable to go in for a dip. However, with a 15 min walk up the beach or the 2 pools at the hotel, we were still able to cool down after a hot day on the table mountain. Big recommendations from me

I planned to be in Cape Town for 8 weeks and was happy to have found this beautiful accommodation. I had to leave earlier due to corona. But the 4 weeks I was there were a blast. Mike is a great guy with a great Musik taste. I updated hafe my playlists :)

Candy’s home is very cozy and has a vintage feel to it which makes it different, it’s close to the beach which is always a win and the deck overlooks an amazing view of the ocean and mountains . Its the perfect getaway if you wanting to go off the grid for a few days and unwind.

Such a little gem of a spot in such an excellent location. The sea views were spectacular, the home beautifully decorated, the beds comfortable and Shari and Derickson were extremely helpful with communication and check in. The value for money was also incredible.
Great house, great location. Nice and spacey. Can get really hot indoors which is why we opted to stay outdoors but the garden was so homey I didn’t mind this at all.

We are a family of four with teenage kids. This is a great apartment for a longer stay in Cape Town. The views are out of this world. We particularly liked the amenities including the outdoor fireplace and the well equipped kitchen. The apartment is very well located and you’re able to travel anywhere around the peninsula easily. Michelle is a great host and the staff, particularly Gertrude, are extremely friendly and helpful.
Beautiful lovely spacious place in a great area, loved the swimming pool.. It can be a bit noisy though when neighbors are around. Other than that it's a great place.
We had a wonderful time ,we loved the privacy and the host's are very welcoming,I'm definitely coming back again

Step out of this oasis of spectacular views and unsurpassed comfort onto the endless stretch of beach and sky. Our two schnauzers had the time of their lives running freely on the beach, playing with the host's dog or sitting gazing at the sea from the reading nook. The bed super comfortable, a walk in closet with tons of space, a private balcony with wrought iron furniture where I sat to watch the sunset and numerous small touches that show hospitable attention to detail. Well done Iris, we hope to be back,
Honestly was the best experience. The house is beyond beautiful and the views are breathtaking. I would recommend all friends and family to come and have a vacation at this house.

The house is beautiful and fully fitted with everything you can think of. The views are so amazing. The place was always clean and the housekeepers were great. Always willing to assist. Was great to watch the sun set every evening.
A stylish and beautifully decorated room. Good coffee and facilities, gorgeous view. Very comfortable bed and pillows. Trudy is a friendly host. Highly recommended
Stunning room with careful consideration given to the needs of anyone staying there. 100% would recommend to anyone, and stay there again.

Very well located to everything and a very well appointed apartment. Loved going downstairs and round the corner were the coffee shops, restaurants, deli, Spar and Woolies a very short walk away. Had to phone Nick once and he was most helpful. A bit noisy at night but the location certainly overrides this minor issue. Convenient to drive to anywhere. Cynthia & Brian

The area ‘Tamboerskloof’ is a very nice base to visit Cape Town if you’re also looking for calm and relaxed place to stay. Carin, the host, is helpful in every way. She makes you feel like home from the moment you park you car in the driveway. The room was super clean and stylish with all amenities there - we loved to beautiful mermaid shower :) I definitely recommend!
Amazing views and sound of the waves. This flat is brand new and modern, the bed was very comfy. Leo is a very friendly and helpful host - we will be back to stay here again in Cape Town!
location was first class, Giovannis deli just stone throw for quick coffee. Bao Kapp and VA walking distance. secure parking. Great find.
Amazing apartment with balcony. Spotlessly clean and sparkling and very very comfortable. Will definately want to rebook next time in capetown! Thankyou!

This was a great place for our first stop with three young children - despite it being beautiful it was also very comfy and functional as a home for us all. the location was good to reach most of the best central beaches, grab a good coffee and get into the city and markets. We did drive most places as have a 1, 3 and just turned 6 year old, but it would have been close walking distance to places too. Hazel welcomed us at the house and despite load shedding it was absolutely fine and the house was well equipped to deal with that and for us a family in general. Thanks for having us!

A compact, cleverly-designed private unit equipped with all the key amenities one might need for a long-term stay. The neighbourhood is generally quiet and the WIFI fast and reliable (even during loadshedding!), making this an ideal environment from which to work remotely. Easy access to the City Bowl and surrounds via Uber and all the usual takeout/grocery apps deliver at one’s convenience. Last but certainly not least, the hosts are genuinely good people. All in all, highly recommended x

When I first stumbled upon this flat on AirBnB, it seemed almost too good to be true. There must be a catch! But everything was as perfect as it seemed online. Brian is the most thoughtful, gracious host.
Enjoyed my stay, close to everywhere I needed to be. Lovely and peaceful. Really enjoyed it

The apartment is in an excellent location, with numerous restaurants and other conveniences within walking distance. The building is well managed and secure. It’s situated in excellent proximity to many of the highlights in the city. The apartment is small, however, it is as advertised and is very efficient. We were traveling with excess luggage and had no difficulty finding proper storage for all of our belongings. The view from the balcony is great!
The appartement is very nice, secure, clean, well equipped and close to the beach. Leroux and Neuza are really nice and helpfull hosts. We'll be glad to return next year!

We had an absolutely wonderful stay and Nicci was the perfect host, so warm and accommodating. Really couldn't fault the place, it was so beautiful and peaceful.....a great place to unwind after a busy day of sightseeing and enjoying the numerous activities that Cape Town has to offer. It's such a central location and Constantia is so beautiful in its own right. Thanks so much for having us Nicci and Chris, we really hope to be back soon!
Incredible accomodation for the whole family. Spacious, comfortable, safe, modern and homely!! Highly recommended spot right on the promenade!!
We came back as we loved it the first time; and it did not disappoint for the second time either. Loved it thanks

Shannon was the perfect host! She met us in the lobby and walked us through a brief registration process. The apartment was exactly as described and you can’t beat the views. Plenty of restaurants within walking distance and the beach was literally across the street. As international travelers we were not super familiar with load shedding so just be prepared for the electricity to go out a couple of times a day. The TV and internet work on a generator so they didn’t go out. Overall, this was an incredible stay and we were sad to leave. Highly recommend this place!!! 5 stars:)

Lovely apartment, close to the beach and restaurants. We felt very safe in the area and could walk to our favorite coffee shops. The apartment could have been cleaner, but other than that, it was a enjoyable stay.
We had such a lovely time. It is truely a wonderful little getaway place and very neat. Eileen is a great host! I strongly recommend her place.

Thanks for my stay, Brian is so friendly and helpful. The bed and bedding was clean and comfortable, the beach is right close if you're a surfer and love nature this is your spot! The restaurants are great! Overall the service was great, love it!
The space has an uplifting, sunny and relaxing atmosphere. It had everything I needed to make me feel at home. The bed was super comfy!

This is as good as it gets! If this place was for sale I would buy it. The location was peaceful and serene, with incredible views. We loved the architecture of the home, the multiple spaces to relax in or take in the views. Sunset saunas we’re a real treat. Wish we could’ve stayed longer…
This was our second time in this wonderful place and we absolutely loved it. Will come back soon!

Nikki was a friendly hostess whose house is peaceful and lovely. The garden is beautiful and we were able to swim - all just a wonderful experience. But the location is the most amazing part - in beautiful Constantia surrounded by forests and wine farms. Highly recommended.

We had a great stay at Stefan's place! It was as described and extremely accessible to the surrounding area. We were a five minute drive from the popular Bree street and we were surrounded by beautiful views and delicious restaurants. Would definitely stay again!
The place is centrally located which gives you easy access. It is clean. the hosts are responsive. I enjoyed the stay

Kevin is a great host, very accommodating, waited for us as our flight was delayed, welcomed us warmly to the Mother city as he handed over his cosy, clean and well kept property. The property had everything that my family could possibly need, located in a quiet safe area, walking distance to the beach, shops and laundromat. The property is ideal for a family, we had a pleasant stay, felt like a home away from home and will be number one on our list next time we visit Cape Town.

Stayed for 2 nights. Felt safe and served its purpose. the apartment smelt a little of damp (possibly the bin cupboard needing deep cleaning). no flexibility on check in/check out time was a bit frustrating. overall thank you for a pleasant stay.

Fantastic location,safe & secure apartment across from the beach.Very modern well maintained apartment.Very comfy,plenty of space to relax.We had everything we needed.Our stay was perfect ,would definitely return. Jillian was a great & friendly host.

We had a lovely stay at Colleens place over the festive season. The cottage is centrally situated to the main Cape Town attractions (10 -15min drive). Colleen was very attentive to our needs and the special touches make it a home away from home. The check-in process was seamless. A definite must book!
The place is as it is on the pictures. Nosipho responds quickly, and that’s what I liked. The flat is peaceful, hardly heard any noise, and the self check in and out came with so much ease
Awesome spot nice and Central and host is very helpful and clear in instructions. WiFi would have made things a bit easier but good value for money and great for weekend away visits
Stylish apartment in an excellent location. Great restaurants, coffee shops and other amenities within easy walking distance. Super easy check-in and the apartment was very clean. Thanks Jacob!

The owners have done a wonderful job creating a beautiful property with a stunning garden and tastefuly finished interiors. The property is better than the pictures and benefits from access to a beautiful nature trail where you can go for lovely walks. The braai (BBQ) area is very well kitted out and great when having a night in. The whole house is very well equipped with everything you need. Gas (the owner) was very pleasant and friendly on check in. The staff onsite were delightful, clean to a high standard and are very helpful. There are secrurity cameras around the perimeter which gives you peace of mind but one camera faces straight at the entertainment area which kind of makes you feel like you are being watched. Overall we had a lovely stay in this beautiful property and the hosts were very accommodating before , during and after our stay.

A huge thank you to Ernest and Danielle for an amazing stay at their Airbnb! The space was immaculate and beautifully decorated, with all the amenities one could ask for. Ernest and Danielle were incredibly welcoming and helpful throughout my stay, making me feel right at home. Highly recommend their Airbnb for anyone looking for a wonderful experience. Thanks again!

Beautiful and spacious apartment with stunning views! The host was friendly and easy to communicate with. Close to the beach, restaurants, and shops. This was the perfect spot for my husband and I to stay while visiting family. Would book again!
Great location, easy check in experience and very flexible. Really good pool area, and plenty of security.
Shari's place was wonderfully located in walking distance of shops and restaurants in Kalk Bay. The apartment was light, clean and very comfortable. We will definitely stay at Shari's place again.

Overall good apartment and location. Check in and check out was very simple and easy. Tips for improvement - more laundry tablets and need some cleaning products and cloths for cleaning tabletops etc. loved the stay and rooms were spacious.
Absolutely phenomenal stay, Charl was exceptionally accommodating and made sure all our needs were met. The house itself was stunning, definitely would recommend!

FANTASTIC VILLA! Excellent location, convenient to walking into town with beach, restaurants, shopping. Villa is gorgeous and even better than photos! It’s clean, modern, well-stocked with stunning views. Annick, Joe and Tammy will take care of your every need. HIGHLY RECOMMEND- 5 Star++!!
Booked the place with two friends and we all loved the place and we are probably going to bring back our families. Super beautiful. Spacious with a modern touch and located at a prime location.

Really great place. Lots of good restaurants nearby. Very close to the best part of the beach in fish Hoek. Good internet. Lots of towels. All mattresses are comfortable, even the bunk bed mattresses. Very responsive and helpful.
Great place to stay , extremely easy to get to the inner city without a hassle. Very well looked after and clean.

This is a fantastic house. The views from all bedrooms are stunning, and the location is convenient—close to the restaurants, bars, and supermarkets. One of the best Airbnb that I rented. It was very comfortable for our group and well-maintained by the adorable and very efficient Judith, who also managed everything to make our stay perfect. Ricardo was very responsive as well, unfortunately, we had an issue with the bathroom and internet but he answered quickly to fix things. We absolutely love this house and hope to come back one day.

Dave's place was our sancury for two weeks of hospital in morning, with rest & work in afternoon. Garden is paradise with birds and a visiting squirrel and very peaceful cats and old friendy dog. Please was quite, clean & peaceful. Wifi good enough to work from.

I recently had an amazing stay at this Airbnb that I absolutely loved. The apartment was clean, beautifully decorated, and felt so cozy and inviting. The host was super friendly and added thoughtful touches that made our stay extra special. The location was perfect, in a safe neighborhood with easy access to local attractions. Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay. 🥰
This was the loveliest AirBnb I have ever stayed in. It is so thoughtfully put together. I'm so happy to be returning next week.

Terry’s is really a home away from home. She’s put a lot of thought into what she includes from the amenities, utensils and even soap for the washing machine. It’s welcoming , modern and aesthetically appealing. She was a fantastic host, always responsive and full of great recommendations for exploring the area. This place truly exceeded our expectations, and we can’t wait to return! Highly recommended for anyone visiting Cape Town.
This place was fantastic to stay in. Lock up garage, walkable to many great restaurants and swimming spots! I would definitely recommend.

Had a 10/10 experience. Kind host, spacious rooms and bathrooms, & great amenities. The cleaners were thorough and came regularly. Ubers were always just 1 min away. There’s a convenience store within the same compound which was amazing for stocking up on snacks and bottled water. Was concerned that there was no AC but there is great air flow throughout the apartment that keeps it cool and comfortable so no need for AC. I would 100% book again :)

The apt was lovely, not the best location for shops, restaurants etc. but exceptional ocean view. Seattle coffee just along the road. The daily cleaning was really good & the girl was lovely. Slight confusion on the actual address & Atlantic View apartments which is what Nox calls it but apart from that everything was really good & would recommend.
Paul and his cohosts were very friendly and helpful. beautiful retro home.. Great views. enjoyed my stay.
It was lovely staying at Wynand’s place in Newlands. It had everything we needed and felt very safe. Wynand was very helpful with our inquiries. Would love to come back :)

Michael is a great host. Very communicative and always available when needed. One of the best hosts I’ve had on Airbnb. The flat is in a great location in Green Point, very walkable to everywhere, especially the waterfront.

This must be one of the best places I've stayed in - also the cleanest! The apartment sits in a great location, with Canal Walk Mall just a short walk away. I loved the gym and the large swimming pool. I also appreciated the thoughtful touches, like the milk, water, and Coke in the fridge. Everything about this place was great, and I will definitely stay there again. Highly recommended!

This gem in Newlands is perfectly located to both relax in a leafy haven and walk to enjoy a bit of the neighbourhood restaurants and shops. The apartment was spotless , had all the necessities and more and the host was responsive and friendly. We especially enjoyed watching the fish in the pond every morning. We would recommend and visit again
Great spot to stay for a business trip, overlooking the CBD and very well located in Greenpoint.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stayed. Also, the communication and consistent checkins was appreciated. This home is perfectly located to everything. We will definitely be returning soon.
The host is very rude .. doesn’t respond in time takes the whole day to respond .. won’t recommend..nearby area a bit ghetto not safe
Our first ever Airbnb experience. Paul contacted us long before our visit to make sure everything went smoothly. I could not recommend Paul as a host enough. We will definitely be back again!

My best AirB&B ever. Superb appartement, with a stunning panoramic view including Waterfront and Table Mountain. Cosy, luxurious, very comfortable with excellent equipment (including a very welcomed Weber BBQ on the terrasse!). This is a high end place, and the location is terrific, with Uber drivers always nearby, making it easy to explore the city with no stress. Jayson’s been very reactive every time I had a question, making the stay perfect.
My mom enjoyed her stay at Esme’s place. My mom found it to be welcoming and enjoyed the conversations with Esme.

Everything was Perfect, the place is close to the mall aswell and the place inside is so beautiful and have a space. But I so wish they can change there remote it’s kind confusing but everything else is perfect

Warm and comfortable private studio in a great location. Large space with separate bedroom, lounge and dining / work area. Great security and very close to central Durbanville which has everything you need including a flagship Woolworths Food Emporium. Eileen was a friendly and helpful host Would highly recommend staying here

Ant met us and shared really clear directions after we checked in. He was super responsive and helpful, the place was comfortable and the view was incredible. The location seems really trendy and with a lot of young people and great energy. We had a wonderful stay!
not enough blankets. room very cold. no aircon or heater. toilet makes noise after flushing and showering.

The place is beautiful, private and with views to literally die for. The host is very helpful, quick on responses. Am definitely recommending this place. Me and the family will be coming back in summer to enjoy the pool.

The place is very spacious and well laid out. After going up the staircase, you enter a full floor with a master bedroom, a large living room, and two additional bedrooms. The balcony is wide and spacious, offering a truly breathtaking view. The cleanliness was excellent, which made the stay even more comfortable and enjoyable.

As a newbie to Airbnb, I’m so glad that Sarah was my first experience and she knocked it out the park. Arriving to a friendly face and cozy environment is just what you need as a home away from home. Sarah’s place is well located to what I needed to do on my trip and she was a gracious host. Totally recommend!
Urban chic apartment in the heart of CT. Clean comfy & convenient location. Dylan was a welcoming host & easy communication. Highly recommended.
